notes: Major code SE29 (AS). Same core as SE27; the Aerospace Structures focus sequence appears on the diploma. Minimum 145 units plus college GE. Verified against catalog.

buckets.label: Introductory Structural Engineering
buckets.note: SE 1, SE 3, SE 9 all confirmed on both catalog and department pages.

buckets.label: Technical electives
buckets.note: 3 preapproved technical electives outside the focus sequence; SE 195/197/198 not allowed.

buckets.label: General education
buckets.note: Minimum 24 units plus college GE. Engineering major bucket. The SE major itself specifies no fixed GE course list; the '24 units plus college GE' requirement is satisfied by the student's college general-education program (each of UCSD's colleges - Revelle, Muir, Marshall, Warren, Roosevelt, Sixth, Seventh, Eighth - defines its own GE / humanities & social sciences sequence). Covered by the college GE section, not by a major-defined course set.

buckets.label: Total program units
buckets.note: Minimum 145 units. Pure minimum unit total for the major: minimum 145 units (per file notes and catalog). No course list; a total/floor count only.
